India bonds rise after flat open as sharp drop in US yields spurs value buying
items.content: The Indian government bond market saw a positive turnaround as US Treasury yields declined, prompting significant value purchases. The benchmark 6.94% bond maturing in 2036 observed a yield of 7.3551% in morning trading. Concurrently, oil prices dipped, fueled by expectations of improved supply following lifted sanctions on Russia. With India's consumer inflation rising to 5.54%, the Reserve Bank of India may respond with tighter financial conditions amidst ongoing capital outflows.

items.content: PSU bank stocks surged up to 8% on Monday, led by Punjab National Bank after its Q2FY27 earnings beat estimates. In contrast, private lenders such as Axis Bank and HDFC Bank fell up to 5% despite reporting profit growth. The Nifty PSU Bank index gained over 2%, while its private-sector counterpart declined.

items.content: Physicists have discovered a strange new state of quantum matter in which ultracold atoms defy familiar organizational rules, forming a highly excited yet surprisingly orderly configuration called a "fractional Fermi sea." The discovery challenges established quantum theories and hints at exotic quasiparticles that scientists have dubbed potential "super-Fermions."

items.title: Magic mushroom ingredient takes the fight out of aggressive fish
items.content: A psychedelic compound found in magic mushrooms appears to have an unexpected effect: calming highly aggressive fish. Researchers discovered that low doses of psilocybin significantly reduced aggressive attacks in mangrove rivulus fish without disrupting their normal social interactions. The findings suggest psilocybin may selectively calm escalating aggression rather than simply suppressing all behavior.
